critique.evidence: Frame delivery is stable: mobile/tablet average about 16.67 ms with 16.8 ms worst frames, and desktop reports no long frames despite a 33.4 ms worst frame. However, standard-mode sampling found zero active animations and zero changed elements at every viewport, so there is no measured proof of polished motion. Reduced-motion is visually static, but still reports one active animation and transition properties on 195–222 sampled elements, so motion is not demonstrably disabled at the implementation level.
critique.fix: Add and measure restrained, purposeful chart/data-state transitions or interaction feedback across all viewports. Under prefers-reduced-motion, explicitly disable animations and transitions so activeAnimationCount and transitionElementCount reach zero, then provide longer before/during/after frame captures and timing for those interactions.
